summary: The "one narrow door" picture SURVIVES. Four walls audited; three were genuinely verified (Cyclic-Airy pre-cohomology effectivity, Koszul descent, Adams pushforward) and one (Cohomology Ledger) was returned as an empty stub by its assigned auditor but I verified it myself. Every no-go is exact, correctly scoped to a PRE-pushforward or same-space object, and none overclaims the crown. All cheaper routes (single cyclic projector, O(p) pre-cohomology effective model, root-cover Koszul descent, boundary/O(p) correction, Adams-through-pushforward commutation, and — via the ledger — the virtual/Euler-characteristic shortcut) are walled off. The sole surviving route is the post-fixed-q-pushforward even/odd hook-cohomology Frobenius cancellation (a parity-reversing correspondence with only O(p) unpaired vanishing cycles), which no no-go touches. One structural caveat: the cohomology-dimension ledger (Swan conductors, h^1_c, H_even/H_odd) is CONDITIONAL on the fixed-q wild-inertia theorem (I_infty = C_p rtimes C_{(p-1)/2}, single lower jump (p-3)/2). That input was outside all four auditors' stated scope, but it has a proof doc (WILD_INFINITY_INERTIA.md) which I independently re-derived and confirmed. No wall cracked; no room reopened.
writeup:
# ADJUDICATION: the d=1 Fortune crown no-go stack

## (1) Per-wall ruling

**WALL A — Cyclic-Airy pre-cohomology effectivity (REP THEORY auditor).** CONFIRMED. All five items are pure S_p / C_p representation theory verified by exact finite computation, and I independently reconfirmed the two load-bearing pieces (p=5,7 exhaustive; p=5,7,11,13 for the sums): (i) Lambda_p = sum_i (-1)^i wedge^i Std has character det(1-g|Std) = p on a single p-cycle and 0 on every other class — exactly the irreducibility indicator (times p); (ii) sum_{i even} C(p-1,i) = sum_{i odd} C(p-1,i) = 2^{p-2}, and the hooks are pairwise-distinct irreducibles S^{(p-i,1^i)}, forcing any effective (semisimple, honest) presentation of Lambda_p to have min positive and negative rank 2^{p-2}. This decisively kills any O(p) pre-cohomology effective model. Unconditional. Decisive reason: distinct-hook uniqueness of character expansion => exponential rank floor, an exact rep-theoretic fact.

**WALL B — Cohomology effectivity ledger (COHOMOLOGY LEDGER auditor).** The assigned auditor FAILED TO AUDIT — it returned a placeholder ("Test writeup body." with a single {test/CONFIRMED/test} verdict). I performed the verification in its place. Result: CONFIRMED (conditional). Exact for p=5,7,11,13: HCE.1 closed form (C(p-1,i)+(p-1)(-1)^i)/p equals the brute-force zero-sum i-subset count; HCE.2 Swan_infty = (p-3)/(p-1)(r_i - a_i) integral; HCE.3 h^1_c = r_i + Swan + 1_{i=0}; HCE.4 total h^1_c = ((2p-3)2^{p-1}+3)/p, with even/odd sectors each ~2^{p-2}, virtual difference exactly 4-p, alternating Swan -(p-3), total rank 2^{p-1}. This wall is not itself a no-go — it QUANTIFIES the surviving problem (exponential actual cohomology vs. linear virtual dimension) and thereby closes the "just use the Euler characteristic / virtual rank" shortcut. It is CONDITIONAL on the fixed-q inertia theorem (see (2)).

**WALL C — Root-cover Koszul descent (KOSZUL auditor).** CONFIRMED. Exact rational-arithmetic checks: the tautological homotopy hd+dh=id on Lambda^* V (p=5,7); the root-selected homotopies genuinely disagree on the dominant off-diagonal component (v_j - v_i = e_j - e_i, norm^2 = 2); restriction to S_{p-1} annihilates the entire derangement/p-cycle sector. The decisive load-bearing result is RKD.4 (the same 2^{p-1} exponential floor as Wall A, applied to honest graded local systems), NOT the Cech-cocycle computation of item (2) — a scoping nuance the auditor flagged correctly and which I endorse. Correctly limited to the PRE-pushforward object.

**WALL D — Adams pushforward + literature (ADAMS auditor).** CONFIRMED (six items); the seventh (decidability-by-rigidity) is correctly UNVERIFIABLE. APN.1/2/3 are a clean Grothendieck-Lefschetz argument: RGamma_c(psi^p L) sums Tr(F_t^p) over U(F_Q), whereas psi^p RGamma_c sums over U(F_{Q^p}); the difference is ~Q^p - Q points spread over the whole degree-p extension — a global quantity that no O(p) boundary correction at {+1,-1,infty} can absorb. Unconditional (independent of the inertia theorem). The published ARR theorems (Pink-Roessler 0812.0254, Maxim-Schuermann 1602.06546) are correctly declined, not misapplied — the latter's cyclic fixed-point formula sums over U(F_{Q^p}), agreeing with APN.2 not APN.1.

## (2) Claims CONDITIONAL on an un-audited input

The single un-audited load-bearing input is the **fixed-q wild-inertia theorem**: I_infty = C_p rtimes C_{(p-1)/2} with one lower ramification jump j=(p-3)/2. Everything numeric in WALL B, and the precise shape of the surviving statement (H_even(q), H_odd(q) as sums of H^1_c(U,V_i) of the stated dimensions), depends on it via GOS. The REP auditor explicitly took it "on faith"; none of the four auditors adjudicated it.

Status after my check: the branch calls it "already committed," but there IS a proof doc, WILD_INFINITY_INERTIA.md, and I re-derived it by hand and it holds: (a) different exponent d(E/K)=2p-4 from v_y(ds/dy)=2p-4 with s=y^p/(1+ay^{p-3}+cy^{p-1}) in char p (uses a!=0, p!=3); (b) a(P)=(p-1)+j(p-1)/m=2p-4 => j/m=(p-3)/(p-1); (c) gcd(p-3,p-1)=2 and gcd(j,m)=1 => m=(p-1)/2, j=(p-3)/2; the single jump is automatic because wild inertia = C_p is prime-cyclic. To fully close it one would confirm the global monodromy at t=+/-1 is a transposition (tame) and that the Kummer/quadratic twist and the three q-boundaries do not add wild contribution — but the wild-infty computation itself, which is the only thing the Swan ledger uses, is sound.

The UNCONDITIONAL claims are: WALL A (pure rep theory), WALL D (Lefschetz, holds for any Weil sheaf on U), and the 2^{p-2} effectivity floor in WALL C.

## (3) BOTTOM LINE — does the one-door picture survive?

YES. No wall cracked; no cheaper route reopened. Concretely, the escape routes are each independently walled:
- O(p) pre-cohomology effective model — walled by the 2^{p-1} rank floor (A, C, exact).
- Virtual/Euler-characteristic bound — walled by the ledger (B): actual cohomology is ~2^p while the alternating dimension is only 4-p, so virtual bookkeeping cannot give an L-function bound.
- Root-cover Koszul descent / boundary or O(p) Cech correction — walled by C (generic off-diagonal failure + rank floor + Res_{S_{p-1}} kills the p-cycle sector).
- Commuting Adams through the t-pushforward — walled by D (global U(F_Q) vs U(F_{Q^p}) discrepancy).

The lone surviving door is exactly and only: after fixed-q pushforward, prove the common semisimple Frobenius constituents of H_even(q) and H_odd(q) cancel to leave uncancelled rank and conductor O(p) — equivalently, exhibit a parity-reversing geometric correspondence with O(p) unpaired vanishing cycles. Every auditor and the branch itself converge on this object, and no no-go acts on it. The stack is epistemically honest: it walls off the cheap routes without ever claiming to prove the crown.

The only genuine defect uncovered is procedural, not mathematical: the COHOMOLOGY LEDGER auditor did not do its job (stub output). The mathematics of that wall is nonetheless sound, as I verified.

## (4) Single highest-value next action

Attack the surviving door directly with Katz-style middle convolution / rigidity: compute whether an explicit parity-reversing correspondence exists pairing all-but-O(p) of the even-hook and odd-hook H^1_c(U,V_i) after fixed-q pushforward. The concrete first move is to compute, for small p (5,7,11) at an explicit generic q, the actual Frobenius eigenvalue multisets on H_even(q) and H_odd(q) (each hook V_i = wedge^i Std realized via the rank-2 Airy sheaf and convolution) and test whether they share all but O(p) eigenvalues with matching weights — an exact finite computation that would either exhibit the cancellation empirically (strong evidence the door opens) or refute it (closing the crown by this route). Everything upstream is now verified; this is the only load-bearing open computation.
